entries.introZh: 在射击游戏中重建方块生存世界，包含地形、森林、矿洞、村庄与夜间出现的怪物。
entries.descriptionOriginal: For the best experience, add -disable_workshop_command_filtering to CS2's launch options: Steam > Library > right-click Counter-Strike 2 > Properties > Launch Options. Without it the map cannot hide CS2's crosshair and weapon list. You join the map. The round timer is gone, your knife is gone, and there is grass under your feet as far as the fog lets you see. This is Minecraft, rebuilt inside Counter-Strike 2 block by block. A world generated from a seed, with hills and forests, caves full of ore, villages along gravel roads and sheep in the meadows. And when the sun goes down: zombies, skeletons, and the quiet hiss of a creeper behind you. Punch a tree. Craft a table. Build a house before the first night, or switch to Creative and build whatever you like. Your world is saved: come back tomorrow and it is waiting for you, exactly as you left it. endless world Plains, forests, deserts and hills, generated from a seed. Dig down for coal, iron, gold, redstone and diamonds. Mine with the right tool, craft in 2x2 and 3x3 grids, smelt in furnaces, store in chests, eat, wear armour, sleep in a bed. Every block and item in the game, and anything breaks in one click. Chickens, pigs, cows, sheep to shear and dye, villagers. At night: zombies, skeletons and creepers. Dust, torches, repeaters, comparators, levers, buttons, pressure plates, lamps, doors and TNT. and building Houses, wells and lamp posts. Ladders, slabs, stairs, fences, beds, coloured wool, and fire that spreads. and night 20 minutes from sunrise to sunset to a sky full of stars. tutorial Your first steps explained, and a Controls page whenever you need it. KeyAction Left clickBreak, attack Right clickPlace, open doors and chests, use levers, eat Mouse wheelHotbar EInventory FOptions RDrop the held item Right click / Ctrl + clickIn the inventory: take half a stack, put down one item Press F to change the game mode, difficulty (Peaceful to Hard), render distance, keep inventory, fire spread, mob griefing, coordinates and the daylight cycle, or to start a New World from any seed you like. If chunks appear slowly on your PC, lower the render distance. The map is made for one player. If you enjoy the map, a like and a favourite help others find it. Every gift and trade means a lot and keeps updates coming.
